seo.title: Sentinel
seo.description: Sentinel turns financial records into intelligence for complex investigations.

hero.title: Follow the money. See the connections.
hero.text: Turn financial records into intelligence for complex investigations. Sentinel connects transactions across accounts and parties, revealing money flows, relationships and patterns that warrant closer examination.

figures.label: Sentinel / 01
figures.title: See the connections. Follow the money.
figures.caption: A connected view of accounts, counterparties and transaction paths.

image.alt: Network map of five entities with a circular flow highlighted

blocks.title: An investigation spans more than one statement.
blocks.text: A single investigation can involve multiple accounts, different banks and thousands of transactions. Sentinel brings those records together and automates analysis, helping investigators examine activity across the whole set.

figures.label: Sentinel / 02
figures.title: From financial records to intelligence.
figures.caption: One connected path from source documents to an investigator’s view.

image.alt: Four steps from records to connections, analysis and reporting

blocks.title: Start with the records you have.
blocks.text: Examine bank statements and accounting records in PDF, Excel and CSV formats, including scanned documents processed through OCR. Connect records from multiple accounts and parties to investigate them together.

figures.label: Sentinel / 03
figures.title: Bring the records together.
figures.caption: Different source formats. Accounts and transactions examined together.

image.alt: PDF, spreadsheet and scanned statements merged into connected transaction records

points.title: Trace the flow
points.text: Follow transfers between accounts and counterparties to understand where funds originate, how they move and where they arrive.

points.title: Reveal relationships
points.text: Identify shared counterparties and connections between parties through transaction analysis and network visualisation.

points.title: Examine patterns
points.text: Explore recurring transfers, concentrations and circular flows. Compare amounts and timing to identify activity that needs further investigation.

blocks.title: Make the investigation clear.
blocks.text: Bring transaction analysis into network maps, charts and investigative reports. Show the relationships, movements and patterns behind the findings, giving teams a clearer basis for review and further enquiry.

figures.label: Sentinel / 04
figures.title: Make the investigation visible.
figures.caption: A financial overview alongside the transactions that warrant examination.

image.alt: Money in and out chart beside a circular flow pattern for review

audience.title: Built for those with a mandate to investigate.
audience.text: For financial investigators, law-enforcement teams, regulators, AML functions, public-sector oversight teams and audit firms examining financial activity.
audience.closing: Tell us about the records you examine and the questions you need to answer.
